name: Viktor
designs: Field of Vision '26 "Gang's All Here" poster
bio_story: Hello, I am Viktor but most people know me as Ramen! My main trade is tattooing, been doing that since 2014. I try to be versatile in style, however my main focus is psychedelic sci-fi fantasia rooted in tattoos of the 80s, 90s, and early 00s. Apart from tattooing I enjoy painting, working on posters, illustrations, merch and a lot of music-related visual stuff! I look into nature, music and psychedelia for inspiration for my art. My good friend once called it "retro stoner fantasy dreams" and I think that sums it up pretty well. For my relation to KGLW, I first encountered them in high school when my mate played Rattlesnake during one class, and I was the kid that 90% of the time just listened to hardcore. Then I saw them live in Prague, the first time they played there in 2022, and they instantly became one of my top fav bands! Since then I've traveled around Europe to see them more, and gathered a small group of awesome friends that travel together. The Athens Residency Tour with these guys was the best music experience of my life, so thanks to my Wooo Gang! We also met a bunch of great GizzHeads from around the world and I have deep love for the Gizz community! Their music inspires a lot of art for me, but as I am a tattoo artist first, I pour a lot of the music into tattoo flash or large projects. One of those was a full sleeve with 26 song references for my great friend! I am aiming to make at least one flash for every KGLW song, and I am at just over 100 now! I hope to see you at a Gizz show in the closest future possible! Take it easy!

name: Julia
bio_story: Hey! I'm Julia, an independent illustrator based in Tbilisi, Georgia. My practice is rooted in observing nature and navigating unfamiliar places, where perception becomes unstable in subtle and interesting ways. I'm interested in how experience reshapes inner structure, how attention, memory and emotion layer over one another. I often listen to King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard during my process. Their music embodies layered systems and shifting structures, echoing my sense that reality is not singular but layered, depending on how it is perceived.

name: Malwina
designs: Hear No, Speak No, See No Evil KGLW baby tee
Hear No, Speak No, See No Evil KGLW 5-panel hats
bio_story: Hi! I'm Malwina, an artist from Poland. I'm a graphic designer by education, but since 2016 I've primarily worked as a tattoo artist. Outside of tattooing, I paint, illustrate, design merch, and take on a variety of creative commissions. I love blending cute and sexy imagery with body horror, gore, and the grotesque. I'm a huge nerd, and most of my inspiration comes from horror films (especially body horror), fantasy and sci-fi, video games, anime, and comic books. I have to admit, I wasn't much of a music person, and until recently I'd only heard of King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard. But then I heard there would be goblins in this collab with Firelight, and that immediately had my attention! I've been listening to the band ever since, and they've completely won me over!
